turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son's gradebook say zero?
I didn't come to be thanked. Owen found out about this zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. What is your explanation?
I have a processing disability. Please give me your main points as a numbered list so I can follow.
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. Withdraw the zero, and tell me who decided to enter it before anyone spoke to Owen.
It is an accessibility need. I really do need it as a list.
You'll have my position in writing, Hale, and you can read it as slowly as you like. For now, I have one question: why was a zero entered before you called me?
